blocks.content: CASSANDRA

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: He has one eye higher than the other.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: Character.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: The stitching is coming loose.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: Battle scar.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: He smells like machine dust.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: So do all great men.
She gave up, which was the right call. Winston and I walked ahead.

We passed the café on Clement and I caught a glimpse through the window of a guy with dark hair, head bent over a sketchbook. I only saw him for a second before Lena said something about inventory and pulled me back.
Something about him registered anyway. Not enough to become a thought. More like a note you can't quite place.
My mom texted while we were still on the block.
Are you with Lena?
Yes. Alive. Supervised. Hydrated. Mostly responsible.
Cassandra.
I tucked the phone away before round two.
The thing about my family is they love me in this very thorough, very careful way. Ever since last year. I understand why. I do. I just sometimes don't want to be the thing that gets loved carefully.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: Do you want to go home?
Gentle question. Harder to dodge than a blunt one.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: No. I want to go somewhere new.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: New where?

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: I'll know when I get there.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: That's not a plan.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: It's an adventure.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: Same thing. Worse branding.
I laughed, but it came out smaller than I meant it to. Lena saw. She always sees. I hate it. I also don't know what I'd do without it.

At the end of the street there was a park. Small, a little forgotten-looking. Stone archway, a fountain that was possibly functional, benches that needed repainting. I'd walked past it a hundred times and never gone in.
Today it looked like somewhere something could happen.

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: There.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: The park?

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: The park.

blocks.speaker: Lena
blocks.content: What's at the park?

blocks.speaker: Cassandra
blocks.content: I'll know when I get there.
